messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 streaming latency > 5s for channel `live-sse` (proxy pool p95/p99 elevated). Possible client stalls / chunking silence. Paging on-call. Grafana: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/streams?panelId=12&from=now-15m

leah: on it. Arjun you're on primary today, can you stand up a quick bridge?

arjun: joining. creating bridge & grabbing logs now. joining-meeting: https://meet.internal/bridges/4943211111

sam: I'm tailing proxy logs (proxy-live-1 / proxy-live-2). seeing repeated keepalive timeouts and write errors: `error: write EPIPE` and `upstream write buffer full` around the same window. pushing logs to #eng-runtime if anyone needs full dump.

mike: client-side metrics look like backpressure spike from some customers — client ACK lagging, KV cache growth. p95 tokens/sec per-connection drops to near 0 for affected sessions. putting small snippet:

```
# sample proxy log
2026-03-15T14:11:02Z proxy-live-1 write_error EPIPE conn=3456
2026-03-15T14:11:03Z proxy-live-1 chunk_emit 0 bytes conn=3456
2026-03-15T14:11:04Z proxy-live-2 keepalive_timeout conn=1290
```

leah: potential triage list: 1) switch affected routes to fallback polling (reduce SSE load) 2) nudge ALB/NGINX keepalive/timeout 3) restart small subset of proxy pods 4) enable temporary aggressive flushing on gateway. agree?

arjun: yep. doing (3) first on canary set to avoid mass disruption. running:

```
kubectl -n streaming rollout restart deploy/proxy-canary
kubectl -n streaming get pods -l app=proxy-canary -o wide
```

ops-bot: Action logged: restart initiated by arjun for proxy-canary at 2026-03-15T14:13:08Z

sam: while that rolls, toggling gateway fallback for route `/v1/live` to polling via feature-flag `sse_fallback=true` (temporary).

kate: quick note — ALB idle timeout is 60s for this stack; we usually put 300s for long-lived SSEs. If many clients have slow consumes, 60s will drop connections and cause re-establish churn. ops, can you raise to 300?

ops-bot: Ticket created: #INC-494321 - ALB idle timeout increase requested (60 -> 300). assignee: kate.

mike: confirming: client backlog metric shows spikes 14:10-14:16. after proxy-canary restart I'm seeing initial improvements on p95 (14:15). still p99 tail remains high for a subset of long-lived sessions.

leah: good. next step: for affected customers we've got two options: a) force route to polling b) throttle/shed lower-priority connections. I prefer (a) short-term for impacted orgs only. arjun please open list of impacted org ids so support can notify.

arjun: creating list now and publishing to #customer-success. impacted orgs: org-558, org-994, org-1212 (partial). notifying support slack group.

sam: also bumping proxy write buffer and increasing tcp window on canary to reduce stalls. config snippet applied to canary:

```
proxy.buffer.write_max: 4MB
proxy.tcp.window: 512k
```

leah: can we validate by replaying a synthetic SSE client? try curl long-lived and inspect chunk arrival.

mike: test command: `curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" https://live.redwood/api/v1/stream/healthz` — watch for regular `data:` chunks. ran at 14:18: successes on canary, main still has some silences.

arjun: can confirm main cluster p99 trending down after config bump + canary -> promote. starting staged promote to primary proxies now.

ops-bot: Action logged: canary promoted to primary by arjun at 2026-03-15T14:22:40Z

leah: support: draft notification to impacted customers: short blurb that we experienced streaming stalls, mitigation in progress, recommend clients re-connect if they see silence. Kate to approve?

kate: approved. sent via support channel.

mike: metrics update: p95 back to normal range by 14:25, p99 improved from ~8s -> ~1.6s by 14:26. some residual single-connection stalls remain but much reduced.

sam: rolling change to gateway feature flag `sse_fallback` off at 14:28 (reverted to normal now that streaming stable).

leah: summary for incident notes: root cause: combination of ALB idle timeout + transient client backpressure causing proxy write buffers to fill, exposing a long-tail p99. Mitigation: 1) raised ALB idle timeout to 300s; 2) config bump on proxies (write buffer/tcp window); 3) restart/promotion of canary proxies; 4) temporary polling fallback for impacted orgs; 5) customer notifications sent.

arjun: leaving bridge. handing off to next oncall (mike) for monitoring and follow-ups. next oncall window starts 2026-03-15T15:00.

mike: ack. I'll monitor p99 for next hour and follow up with a short postmortem if we see recurrence.

incident-bot: RESOLVED: p99 streaming latency alert cleared at 2026-03-15T14:36:17Z. Closing page.

leah: thanks all. recording action items to the incident tracker: #INC-494321.

kate: +1 great coordination.
